sents.zh: 唐朝有一个很有名的诗人，叫李白。
sents.en: The Tang dynasty had a very famous poet called Li Bai.
He travelled to many places in his life.

sents.zh: 因为他常常在外面，所以很少回家。
sents.en: Because he was so often away, he seldom went home.

sents.zh: 他最喜欢的东西是月亮。
sents.en: What he loved most was the moon.

sents.zh: 有一天晚上，他一个人住在外面。
sents.en: One night he was staying somewhere far from home, alone.

sents.zh: 那天天气很好，一点风也没有。
sents.en: The weather that night was fine, without a breath of wind.

sents.zh: 他起来的时候，看见地上白白的。
sents.en: When he got up, he saw the ground was white.

sents.zh: 他一开始以为地上是水。
sents.en: At first he thought there was water on the ground.

sents.zh: 后来他才发现，那是月亮的光。
sents.en: Only then did he realise it was moonlight.

sents.zh: 他看着月亮，想起了很远的家。
sents.en: Looking at the moon, he thought of his home far away.

sents.zh: 他想到了妈妈，也想到了以前的朋友。
sents.en: He thought of his mother, and of old friends.
His heart felt a little sad.

sents.zh: 所以他坐下来，写了一首不长的诗。
sents.en: So he sat down and wrote a short poem.

sents.zh: 这首诗只有四句，可是大家都记得。
sents.en: The poem has only four lines, but everyone remembers it.

sents.zh: 因为不在家的人看月亮的时候，也会想起家。
sents.en: Because people away from home think of home when they look at the moon.
